verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a first-party Structured Outputs capability that constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process the generated data reliably. This matches the core of the story. Missing for 10: details on schema feature support, strict-mode guarantees, grammar-based constraints, per-model availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration that parsing is reliable.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably.
